status: Authored source-based acceptance expectations; these full transitions were NOT executed by this reviewer.

groups.given: Valid acquired provider is retrained away; Flora owner still alive and otherwise eligible, no casting route currently remains.
groups.expected: Permit a new paid Flora creation and legal command/Burst through the existing feat; retain exact chosen ability and current PB. Do not qualify a NEW casting-prerequisite acquisition from the removed route.

groups.given: Provider charge/RP empty or provider temporarily unable to cast; compare Silence and an effect expressly suppressing Flora itself.
groups.expected: Casting-only loss/depletion does not disable nonspell Flora. Audible commands fail under Silence unless an actual permitted visible channel works. Apply actual Flora/plant suppression to its stated scope; do not invent immunity to suppression.

groups.given: Original provider snapshot missing, foreign, invalid, or chosen only after acquisition; compare a properly recorded STR/DEX provider.
groups.expected: Reject/unestablish the incomplete grant rather than choosing a default; retain legitimate STR/DEX as well as other source abilities. No narrowing to mental abilities.

groups.given: Owner PB4, chosen ability16 gives DC15. The route is lost and a different acquired route has ability20.
groups.expected: Continue DC15, not17 from the new route. A genuine change of the bound ability to18 gives DC16 for later applicable tests, without rewriting completed results or body HP.

groups.given: First plant created at t=0, deadline60; unused second permission; first destroyed/uprooted/burst-consumed at t=18.
groups.expected: Close second window at18; an otherwise legal additional Action at24 is refused. Keep original spent rest use, ended body, conditions ending with its generator, and cause/time history.

groups.given: Second plant actually created at t=6 with deadline66; first ends at t=18.
groups.expected: Second remains until its own actual ending/deadline66, with no additional creation restored. It cannot be recreated if later destroyed.

groups.given: First created at total8 with PB3 and HP8 at0/deadline60; genuine total10/PB4 advancement at6; actual unused Action at12 and first remains alive.
groups.expected: Capacity becomes2 without refilling creationUses=0 or healing first. Additional Action may consume the existing one-window permission; second HP9 at creation and own deadline72. First stays HP8/max8. The old fixed-level rejection is not retained.

groups.given: As FLA-07, but reach10 at/after t=60, or first ended at5, or extra permission already spent.
groups.expected: No old-window second creation. An extra Action, level/source/scene relabel or additional round cannot reopen it.

groups.given: Legal command BA and offense commitment before an intervening owner incapacity or death; same plant remains and actual chosen outcome is still legal.
groups.expected: Keep BA/offense spent; resolve once after that original regular turn using the preserved attached phase and continuing lawful owner DC record. New personal actions remain prohibited while incapable/dead.

groups.given: Legal received command followed by Silence, loss of sight, separation beyond60, or plant Deafened after already receiving it.
groups.expected: These alone do not revoke the delivered instruction. At phase retain actual plant/target legality and any independently imposed plant incapacity. No new remote command becomes legal.

groups.given: Before command: no legal sensory channel or owner incapacitated. Contrast valid commitment followed by selected plant destruction, incapacitation/suppression at phase, expired body or illegal target.
groups.expected: Precommit rejection spends nothing. Postcommit failure closes the paid pending outcome without refund/retarget/rescheduling. The same distinction applies when no nominated surviving Lash origin can support the selected target.

groups.given: One of two nominated Lash origins ends before phase; compare losing the only selected Spore/Entangle origin and changing occupants of a fixed Entangle square.
groups.expected: A surviving originally nominated lawful Lash origin can still support the one same-target outcome. No mode/origin substitution for lost fixed Spore/Entangle source. A valid fixed area affects actual phase-time occupants including allies.

groups.given: Owner legally commits an offensive Flora command then an armed plant receives an otherwise qualifying hostile entry before phase.
groups.expected: Shared owner-round allowance is already spent by command; entry yields no extra offense. Phase spends it no second time. Earlier entry instead blocks a later command. Saving throws do not refund it.

groups.given: Already armed surviving plant; owner dies without offense spent in this numbered round; actual first eligible hostile entry, and later another actual round/entry.
groups.expected: Existing entry exception may resolve with old owner identity/continuing DC and normal first-entry/shared-round cap; no living-owner/new command test. Death/return/extra turns themselves reset nothing. Other companions of that owner share the same cap.

groups.given: Owner temporarily incapable across phase: compare already committed command, never-issued command, missed phase, and a genuinely authorized extra turn.
groups.expected: Only actual received pending command may resolve at its scheduled phase. No retrospective issuance or backlog on recovery; extra turn yields no second attached phase or owner-round offense.

groups.given: Legal Burst commits while first still active, then its body is consumed as required; compare an already destroyed plant before attempted Burst.
groups.expected: First case resolves its one bound burst after required consumption, closing unused second window and generator conditions. Second is illegal precommit with no paid Burst/refund. No same-body command or second burst occurs.

groups.given: Owner dies with a lawful timed ability modifier already due to expire before a later trap save.
groups.expected: Use continuing original owner stat history including actual expiry, not a frozen favorable score, default0, replacement provider or a new owner. No actual missing source operand is invented.

groups.given: Verdant Bond owner only; compare actual surviving Conjure Flora plus legal Druid/Ranger/Shaman cast and an ended generator.
groups.expected: Verdant alone produces no Flora; its independent current spell predicates remain. Flora nonspell DC gets no Verdant spell bonus. An active plant supports the stated active-Flora predicates only; no benefit from an ended body. All reports remain conditional; no promotion.

scope: Only the four source questions and directly coupled closure/evidence distinctions; not full335 acquisition/use coverage.
